fact: 1934年6月6日，罗斯福签署《1934年证券交易法》（Securities Exchange Act of 1934，公法73-291，48 Stat. 881），该法规范证券二级市场交易，并成立美国证券交易委员会（SEC）负责执行联邦证券法。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Securities Exchange Act of 1934
sources.quote: enacted June 6, 1934... The 1934 Act also established the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the agency primarily responsible for enforcement of United States federal securities law.

fact: 东德克萨斯油田1930年10月3日由哥伦布·乔伊纳的Daisy Bradford 3号井在地下3536英尺处喷油发现，初喷6800桶每日；到1934年该油田已大量产油，基尔戈市中心曾聚集逾1000口活跃油井，成为世界上最密集的石油开发区。

sources.title: Wikipedia, East Texas Oil Field
sources.quote: on October 3, 1930, his Daisy Bradford No. 3 well hit oil at 3,536 feet below ground surface... oil gushed over the derrick before Laster directed the 6800 BOPD flow into storage tanks... downtown Kilgore had more than 1,000 active wells clustered in a tight area, making it the densest oil development in the world.

fact: 1934年证券交易法要求资产超过1000万美元的发行人按第12、13、15条向SEC定期报送公司信息（年报等），并规范交易所、经纪交易商与自律组织；第10(b)条与Rule 10b-5为反欺诈兜底条款。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Securities Exchange Act of 1934
sources.quote: the 1934 Act requires that issuers regularly file company information with the SEC on certain forms... Many plaintiffs in the securities litigation field plead violations of section 10(b) and Rule 10b-5 as a catch-all allegation.

fact: 1933年证券法规范证券一级发行，1934年证券交易法规范二级市场交易；两法共同构成美国金融市场及其参与者监管的基础。1934年后上市公司须向SEC披露财务信息，内幕交易与操纵市场受联邦法约束。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Securities Exchange Act of 1934
sources.quote: A landmark piece of wide-ranging legislation, the Act of 34 and related statutes form the basis of regulation of the financial markets and their participants in the United States.

fact: 东德克萨斯油田1930年发现后，大量油井在 connected 油藏上密集钻探，产能激增导致油价暴跌；这是美国本土首次在北美大陆发现如此大规模的油藏，几乎任何位置钻井都能产出高品位石油。

sources.title: Wikipedia, East Texas Oil Field
sources.quote: Within a few months, drillers, landowners, and investors began to realize they had a spectacular oil field two thirds of a mile under their feet, one that would produce enormous quantities of high-grade oil almost anywhere they drilled.

fact: 东德克萨斯油田主油藏位于地下3501英尺以下；早期因钻井技术不足多以干井和破产告终，直到1930年用取芯与钻杆测试技术在3411英尺取芯见9英寸油砂、3486英尺钻杆测试见油气后才成功喷油。

sources.title: Wikipedia, East Texas Oil Field
sources.quote: drilling technology had not progressed sufficiently to reach oil at the depths it is found there, which are mainly below 3,501 feet... On 20 July 1930, Laster took a core sample at 3,411 feet, which showed 9 inches of oil sand. On 5 September 1930, a drill stem test at 3,486 feet showed oil and gas.

fact: 东德克萨斯油田发现后，H.L. Hunt等独立石油商在油田南部钻探；Joiner因无力开发将权益出售给Hunt。1930-1934年间，油商、地主、投资者在基尔戈、格莱德沃特等城镇聚集，形成密集石油开发区。

sources.title: Wikipedia, East Texas Oil Field
sources.quote: On 16 December, H.L. Hunt well to the south of the Joiner well, produced under 100 BOPD... drillers, landowners, and investors began to realize they had a spectacular oil field.

fact: 1934年美国仍处于大萧条恢复期；1934年证券交易法要求上市公司披露财务信息后，纽约证券交易所与场外市场的信息成本结构改变——投资者不再只能靠报纸印刷价与电话口头交易。具体物价与工资数据未在本包取得系统统计。
